captain_obvious_law: SAFE_REDUCTION + POLY_CHECK is insufficient without GUARANTEED_PROGRESS + POLY_TERMINAL_CLASS.

confirmed: SAT preprocessing contains genuine decision-safe deletions such as BVE, BCE, subsumption, unit propagation and autarky-like reductions.
Lean/stalled cores are a natural consequence when a selected safe-reduction system has no further applicable rule.
Structured and parameterized compression can be polynomial on declared classes without extending to unrestricted SAT.
barriers: General exact knowledge-compilation representations can have exponential lower bounds.
Strong generic SAT instance compression is complexity-theoretically nontrivial.
Sparse CNF structure alone does not imply an easy SAT instance.

next_gate_firewall: Exactly one new polynomial-time recognizable proof-carrying mechanism may be added. If it only moves the stall, preserve the new stall before adding anything else.
